evidence_receipt.claim: Click's ANSI matcher only recognizes numeric parameters separated by semicolons.
evidence_receipt.falsification_condition: The updated regular expression in line 14 matches ANSI escape sequences with parameter bytes in the range 0x30-0x3F (which includes digits, semicolon, and question mark), as well as intermediate bytes (0x20-0x2F) and a final byte (0x40-0x7E).
